What changed

Quieter wood grain and parchment edges. Consistent rounded cards. Shallow brass highlights. Short press and panel transitions. A compass that fits narrower cards. The header, resources, tabs, wording, and game actions retain their existing roles.

OPTIONAL · NOT IMPLEMENTED

A more compact phase header

A later layout pass could make the phase explanation more compact to show more game content on small phones. At 320 px with 200% text and long names, the fixed header leaves very little content space. This would change the layout and needs separate approval.

More motion: approved for the app

The approved build uses a 350 ms entrance, a four-second lantern-light cycle on the parchment, and a six-second brass shimmer on an enabled primary button. Try Lantern / Sites and type “anchor” to enable the button. Reduce motion or Pause decorative loops stops the effects.

The React Native implementation uses the installed Animated API to move and fade static SVG layers. It adds no dependencies. Decorative loops stop offscreen and in the background, honor reduced motion, and use isInteraction: false. Compass readings and game actions retain their existing behavior. Native appearance and battery impact still need device testing.

This is an HTML approximation of the React Native presentation. Native font rendering, shadows, and animation performance still need a device check.
